SELECT b.prodName, SUM(b.orderCount) AS orderCount, SUM(b.totalAmount) AS totalAmount, SUM(b.totalPrintCount) AS totalPrintCount
FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN a.orderCount < #{etcThreshold} THEN '기타' ELSE a.prodName END AS prodName,
a.orderCount, a.totalAmount, a.totalPrintCount
FROM ( SELECT 품목명 AS prodName,
COUNT(*) AS orderCount,
COALESCE(SUM(결재금액), 0) AS totalAmount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN 인쇄도수 = '1도인쇄' THEN 1 WHEN 인쇄도수 = '2도인쇄' THEN 2 WHEN 인쇄도수 = '3도인쇄' THEN 3 WHEN 인쇄도수 = '4도인쇄' THEN 4 WHEN 인쇄도수 = 'CMYK인쇄' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN 인쇄면 = '단면' THEN 1 WHEN 인쇄면 = '양면' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN isnumber(replace(제작장수, ',', '')) THEN CAST(replace(제작장수, ',', '') AS integer) ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN 인쇄방법 IN ('실크인쇄', '간편인쇄') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS totalPrintCount
FROM public.인쇄정보
WHERE 주문일자 like #{startDate} || '%'
AND coalesce(배분여부, 'false') = #{distributeYn}
AND coalesce(기존주문여부, '신규주문') = #{existOrderYn}
GROUP BY 품목명
) a
) b
GROUP BY b.prodName
ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.prodName = '기타' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, b.prodName
